Sed is in next week, so is it allowed or not for this Week’s Grpas?

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked: I believe yes (@sayan can confirm this better), but there are also other ways of replacement already discussed in the content so far that don’t require sed.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: I suggest using bash scripts as in OPPE, you might not get the option to use sed directly (.sed file). Meaning you cannot use script.sed in place of script.sh.
